_comment: THE ORGANISM AUDIT §10-C · rung S3 (20 Aug 2026). knip answers ONE question no other instrument here answers: which exported symbol does nobody import? In an organism whose organs are CLIs, an orphan export is not automatically dead code — it can be a writer another organ is SUPPOSED to call through (CLAUDE.md's owners-only rule names exactly that path) and never does. That is why knip's findings enter as LEADS, never as REDs: §4's rule binds every new instrument, and a lead is a lead until one run verifies it. scripts/lawpack.mjs prints them and counts them; it never fails a build on them.
